name: Teacher Kurihara
source:
The homeroom teacher of the Amanogawa sisters' class. Due to suffering from trouble makers, this teacher does not part with their stomach medicine.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20041022050240/http://www.pandahouse.net/pandahouse/zoo/waki.html]official site[/url].]
